overall_intent: Independent random country selection chose China. I compared a frontal throne portrait with a doorway pause and chose the latter for an inhabited court moment, legible sleeve/folding mass, and a reason for the document. Late Qing is agent-selected staging, with contemporary reference hair retained explicitly; the image is a costume reconstruction rather than historical documentary evidence. The viewer should feel poised anticipation and subtle personal appeal. Setting, costume details and hand action remain agent-owned and may be refined locally at creativity 1.

garment_detail.reason: The court costume must present inspectable garment form at the portrait scale.
garment_detail.expressive_goal: A coherent long Chinese court robe whose sleeve and closure construction reads in a threshold portrait.
observable_targets: wide sleeves emerging above document-supporting hands
owner_relations: both hands support the document folio below the sleeves
required_constraints: Preserve supplied face and short dark bob
Keep reference use restricted to face and hair appearance
preserved_choices: Contemporary staged late Qing palace reconstruction
open_scope: robe construction and local surface detail
garment_detail.role_focus: Late Qing Chinese palace court robe construction, visible collar, sleeve shape and closure on a woman holding a document folio at waist height.
garment_detail.scene_context: Contemporary historical costume reconstruction at a half-open vermilion doorway; short dark bob retained from supplied appearance reference. Face, robe, both hands and folio are seen together from head to below the knees.

grounds.quote: A woman in a reconstructed Chinese palace court costume photograph, using supplied face and hair appearance.

review.rationale: Garment construction is open, and its local refinement can distinguish court attire without changing the reference face or hair. No candidate information was used to author this expression plan.
